messages:
deploybot: Incident detected in eu-inference (eu1). Pausing all release slots and pinning current stable version. Hold ID: HLD-2026-03-21-01. Reason: spike of 503s from cache layer.

mira: acknowledging, pulling kvcache logs now.

ash: thanks — do we want to rollback 2026.03.21-rc5 or keep the pinned version and triage?

sienna: lean toward keeping pinned. rollback could be noisy; only rollback if we see regressions downstream. :thinking_face:

jon: ops here — can we target a soft window at 03:00 UTC to finish any required restarts? if we need immediate traffic mitigation we can shift canary to 0% and replay later.

mira: found thundering herd on p-prod-cache eu1 after last shard change. restarting cache nodes 3/4 to drain load.

release-manager: I'll draft a short customer-facing note: "Temporary pause on EU canaries due to cache instability; investigating. No data exposure." Will post to status once we confirm.

ash: command for restart I used:
```
kubectl rollout restart statefulset/p-prod-cache -n infra-eu1 --selector=group=kv
```

incident-bot: Restart job scheduled, job-id 28374; monitoring metrics for error rate and latency.

mira: cache restart completed, 503s down to baseline in last 5m. running a 15m stability window before lifting hold.

deploybot: Hold HLD-2026-03-21-01 will be released if stability window holds. Rescheduling remaining slots to next change window 04:00 UTC and reducing canary size to 10% for safety.

jon: sounds good. update release notes with the softbackfill plan.

release-manager: note posted on status page and internal release notes updated. I'll follow up with ops for final go/no-go at 03:50 UTC. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Hold released at 1775010200. Proceeding with staggered rollout per updated plan.
